description: A1 is coordinating the preservation of a box of family cassette tapes and must decide which tapes to digitize, what equipment and format to use, when to hold the session, and how to store the originals after checking in with the other two family members.

agents.name: Mina
agents.role: Family Archive Coordinator and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has 24 cassette tapes containing old conversations, songs, and recordings from relatives, and everyone wants a preservation plan.
shared_context.S2: Mina is coordinating the digitization session and will make the final decisions about the tapes, equipment, timing, file format, and storage.
shared_context.S3: The tapes are currently kept together in a labeled cardboard box at Mina's house.
shared_context.S4: Before Mina announces the plan, the family's usual practice is to go around the room and let each person share any practical information or preference that should shape the arrangement.
shared_context.S5: The digitization session will be informal and can be held at Mina's house.

PF1.text: Leo owns a working Type I cassette deck that he can lend for the session, but he can bring it only on Saturday between 10:00 and 14:00.

PF2.text: A3 spoke with Mei, a local archivist, who reviewed the tape labels and recommended digitizing tapes 1 through 18 at 24-bit WAV quality and storing the original cassettes in an acid-free box; Mei's recommendation has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: Tapes 1 through 18 and only those tapes must be selected for digitization.
Leo's Type I cassette deck must be selected as the equipment.
The session must be scheduled for Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00.
The files must be created in 24-bit WAV format.
The original cassettes must be stored in an acid-free box.
A commitment to bring and use Leo's deck during the session must exist.
Sofia's archivist recommendation must be spoken aloud and cited by Mina.

decisive_facts.why: Leo's specific Type I deck and its Saturday 10:00-14:00 availability change the equipment choice, fix the session window, and make the matching equipment commitment possible.
Mei's recommendation changes the selection to exactly tapes 1 through 18, sets the file format to 24-bit WAV, and changes original storage to an acid-free box.
